1.why: All five are plain intransitive verbs with no shared frame to perturb; nothing separates them without the stem.

2.why: All five share the -less suffix; 'spotless' is the only positively valenced member, but that is as likely a decoy as a key.

3.why: Mixed physical and affective adjectives with no cluster; 'dreary' is the only mood word, weakly.

4.why: Five unrelated transitive verbs at the same register and specificity; nothing leaks.

5.why: Relations split 2 instrument (grind:mill, brew:kettle) and 2 product (knead:bread, churn:butter), leaving tan:hide the lone material relation.

6.why: All five are two-word phrasal verbs of motion; 'spread out' is the only expansion among contraction/separation senses, which is thin.

7.why: Four are container parts/attachments and crate:fruit is container:contents; among the parts, cork:bottle is the tightest defining-function pair.

8.why: Patriot, apprentice, arbiter and hermit all stand in a supportive or constitutive relation to the second term; iconoclast:custom is the only oppositional pair, and the only one whose relation is definitional.

9.why: Carpenter:workbench and baker:oven pair off as worker:tool, so the key is one of the three singletons; sculptor:statue is the canonical worker:product.

10.why: Girder:steel and quarry:stone are material/source pairs; trellis:vine is the tightest support-function pair, but awning:shade is an equally clean function pair.

11.why: Sermon:congregation and anthem:nation share the utterance:audience frame, so the key is likelier a singleton, and joke:laughter is the tightest cause:effect.

12.why: All five end in -ous and tedious/laborious are near-synonyms, so neither can be a unique key, but that only narrows to three.

13.why: Five common character adjectives at one register with no cluster or perturbation axis.

14.why: Satire:novelist is the odd one by word class (only one with a person), and diatribe:censure is the only genre:purpose pair, which is the tighter relation.

15.why: All five are un- prefixed; 'unrivaled' is the only positive one, a weak valence tell.

16.why: Concrete nouns (stain, mess, shortage) versus abstract (silence, delay) with no clean centre; effectively unconstrained.

17.why: Kiln and polish are improvements while erosion, tarnish and mildew are degradations; mildew:fabric is the cleanest agent-damages-material pair.

18.why: Wave:shore, pebble:beach, crater:moon and glacier:ice are location or composition pairs; dune:wind is the only formed-by-agent relation.

19.why: Stubborn, talkative, wasteful and showy are transparent everyday adjectives while 'surly' is the single elevated-register word, the standard register outlier.

20.why: All five are legislative verbs and enforce/endorse form a near-minimal pair; 'repeal' is the most specific, but specificity here is not decisive.

21.why: Usher, patron and critic relate to a place or object rather than custody; archivist:records is the only custodian-of-the-material pair.

22.why: Five unrelated physical-process verbs with no shared frame.

23.why: All five are -ing participial adjectives naming an effect on a person; no one member differs in class, register, or specificity.

24.why: Luminous, sterile, opaque and brittle each ascribe a property present in the second term; insipid:flavor is the only privative pair (lacking the named quality), a unique relation type.

25.why: Bark:tree and resin:pine pair as plant products, leaving mortar, vein and knot as singletons with no way to choose among them.

26.why: 'Echo' is the only auditory verb among four visual/physical ones, but the modality split does not say which side the key is on.

27.why: Honey:bee and lemon:fruit are source/category pairs; salt:preserve is the only substance:function pair, matching vinegar:sour only loosely.

28.why: Stingy and greedy form an acquisitiveness pair, so neither is likely a unique key, yet the remaining three are undifferentiated.

29.why: Saddle:horse, swarm:bee, hive:honey and pasture:fence are gear, group, product and boundary relations; burrow:rabbit is the only dwelling:dweller pair.

30.why: Tadpole, calf and fledgling cluster as juvenile animals, and tadpole:frog is the only clean young:adult pair among them.
